item.title: GOP reaches key 50-vote threshold for Trump-backed voter ID bill as Senate fight looms
item.description: Sen. Mike Lee, R-Utah, leads the campaign to win 50 Republican votes for a conservative voter ID bill, but Senate Democrats plan to block the SAVE America Act in Congress.

item.title: Tom Emmer blasts Democrats' double standard on SAVE Act: 'They require photo IDs' at their own DNC
item.description: House GOP Whip Tom Emmer blasts Democrats over photo ID rules at the DNC, arguing their stance undercuts their opposition to the SAVE Act and exposes hypocrisy on election security.

item.title: Actress Natasha Rothwell goes off-prompter to say ‘f--- ICE’ at Independent Spirit Awards
item.description: Natasha Rothwell, an actress and former writer for "Saturday Night Live," took a moment during an award show to condemn ICE, sparking applause in the audience.

item.title: Swalwell's 'I should be working' gym, pool videos resurface as Dem rival hammers his missed House votes
item.description: Rep. Eric Swalwell's pool and gym videos are resurfacing in California's governor race as his opponent's campaign hammers him for missing votes on Capitol Hill.

item.title: Thune guarantees voter ID bill to hit the Senate despite Schumer, Dem opposition: 'We will have a vote'
item.description: SAVE America Act faces Senate filibuster hurdle despite 50 GOP backers as Republicans weigh talking filibuster option to advance voter ID requirements.

item.title: California school board member temporarily banned from school after clash with principal over ICE protests
item.description: Pajaro Valley Unified School District trustee Gabe Medina faces campus ban following heated confrontation with principal during student walkout protests in Watsonville, California.

item.title: Controversial skier Eileen Gu settles for silver after defending gold medal bid falls short in Milan
item.description: Eileen Gu won silver in the freeski big air event at the 2026 Milan Cortina Olympics, as she was unable to defend her gold from the 2022 Beijing Games.

item.title: 100 US troops land in Nigeria as Islamic militants threaten West Africa regional security
item.description: Nigeria counterterrorism efforts receive U.S. military support as American advisers arrive to help combat Boko Haram and Islamic State West Africa Province attacks.

item.title: Trump says 'this is a Democrat shutdown' as he touts low inflation, falling murder rate
item.description: President Donald Trump blamed Democrats for the partial government shutdown while claiming economic wins including lower gas prices and inflation.
